itemDisplayName: Public Bring-Your-Own-Model with Azure API Management
description: Layers a public (non-VNet) Azure API Management AI Gateway in front of an existing backend Foundry account and adds a Bring-Your-Own-Model (BYOM) connection to an existing Foundry project. Public counterpart of the private cross-region BYOM extension. Demonstrates the bring-your-own-model pattern documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway.
summary: Existing project + existing backend Foundry account bridged by a public StandardV2 APIM — project MI authenticates to APIM, APIM mints tokens for the backend, model deployments surface as <connection>/<deployment> in agent code.
